title: Claude 中考英语模拟卷（一）
source: Claude（Opus 5.5）按中考考点原创出题，短文均为原创
note: 按全国中考常见题型原创，文章均为新写，可打印

items.stem: —Is this your notebook? —No, it isn't. ____ is on my desk.
items.exp: 空处作主语，指“我的笔记本”，用名词性物主代词 mine。

items.stem: My cousin has been a volunteer at the city library ____ two years.
items.exp: two years 是一段时间，现在完成时中用 for 接时间段；since 后接时间点。

items.stem: —____ do you practise playing the piano? —Three times a week.
items.exp: 答语是频率 three times a week，用 how often 提问。

items.stem: The new bridge ____ last year, and now it takes us only ten minutes to cross the river.
items.kp: 一般过去时的被动语态
items.exp: bridge 与 build 是被动关系，last year 表示过去，用 was built。

items.stem: Lucy is ____ girl in our class. She always helps others with a smile.
items.exp: in our class 表示范围，用最高级；kind 的最高级是 kindest。

items.stem: You ____ hand in your homework today. Tomorrow is also OK.
items.exp: 后句说明天也可以，说明今天“不必”交，用 needn't。

items.stem: I don't know ____ the school trip will start. Let's ask Mr. Green.
items.exp: 根据句意“不知道春游什么时候开始”，用 when 引导宾语从句，并用陈述语序。

items.stem: If it ____ tomorrow, we will have the sports meeting in the gym.
items.exp: if 引导的条件状语从句遵循“主将从现”，用一般现在时 rains。

items.stem: The film was so boring that many people fell ____ before it ended.
items.exp: fall asleep 意为“睡着”。

items.stem: —Would you mind ____ the window? It's a little cold. —Of course not.
items.exp: mind 后接动词 -ing 形式：mind doing sth.。

items.stem: We should try our best to ____ the problem of plastic waste.
items.exp: deal with the problem 意为“处理问题”。

items.stem: The boy ____ is wearing a blue cap is my brother.
items.exp: 先行词 the boy 指人，在从句中作主语，用 who。

items.stem: —I'm going to take part in the speech contest tomorrow. —____
items.exp: 对方明天参加比赛，应祝好运。

items.stem: My grandma ____ in the garden when I got home yesterday.
items.exp: when 引导的时间状语表示“我到家时”，奶奶正在做某事，用过去进行时。

items.stem: —Could you tell me ____? —Sure. Go along this street and you'll find it on your left.
options: how can I get to the post office
how I got to the post office
items.exp: 宾语从句用陈述语序；D 时态不对。

sections.title: The Old Bike
sections.passage:
When I was twelve, my father gave me an old bike. It was (16) and the bell did not work. I felt a little (17) because my classmates all had new bikes.
One Saturday, my father said, "Let's (18) it together." We spent the whole afternoon in the yard. He showed me how to fix the chain, and I (19) the bike bright blue. By evening, it looked (20) new.
The next Monday, I rode it to school. To my (21), my best friend said, "Wow, where did you buy such a cool bike?" I told him the story (22) .
Now I have a new bike, but I still keep the old one. It (23) me that something old can become special if you put your (24) into it. The time I spent with my father was the best (25) of all.

items.exp: 旧车“脏”且铃不响，与后文清洗修理呼应。
同学都有新车，自己只有旧车，感到有点难过。
后文“修链条、刷漆”，说明父亲提议一起修。
paint the bike bright blue 把车漆成亮蓝色。
look like new 看起来像新的一样。
to one's surprise 令某人惊讶的是。
被朋友夸奖，开心地讲述修车的故事。
remind sb. that... 提醒某人……
put your heart into it 用心投入。
和父亲一起度过的时光是最好的“礼物”。

groups.label: A
groups.title: Summer Courses at Sunshine Youth Center

items.stem: Which course is held at the weekend?
items.exp: 摄影课在周六上课。

items.stem: How much does a 15-year-old student pay for First Aid Basics?
items.exp: 急救课对 16 岁以下学生免费。

items.stem: What can students get after the First Aid course?

items.stem: Where can we probably read this text?

groups.label: B
groups.title: A Library on Wheels
groups.passage:
In a small mountain village, there was no library, and many children had never read a storybook. Ms. Wang, a young teacher, decided to change that. She bought an old van, painted it yellow, and filled it with more than 600 books.
Every Friday afternoon, she drives the "book van" from one village to another. When the children hear her music, they run out of their houses. They can borrow two books each time and return them the next week.
At first, some parents thought reading was a waste of time. "Children should help on the farm," they said. Ms. Wang did not give up. She invited the parents to a story evening and read aloud with their children. Slowly, the parents changed their minds.
Now the book van visits six villages. Some older students even help Ms. Wang choose new books. "Books open a window to the world," she says. "Every child should have the chance to look out of it."

items.stem: Why did Ms. Wang buy an old van?
options: To carry books to the children.
To take children to the city.
items.exp: 她买旧车装满书，开到各村让孩子借书。

items.stem: How many books can a child borrow each time?
items.exp: They can borrow two books each time.

items.stem: How did Ms. Wang change the parents' minds?
options: By helping them on the farm.
By asking the headmaster for help.
items.exp: 她邀请家长参加故事晚会，和孩子一起朗读。

items.stem: What does Ms. Wang mean by "Books open a window to the world"?
options: Books can help us see and learn about the wider world.
Reading near a window is good for our eyes.
Children should build windows for the library.
Books are more important than farm work.
items.exp: 比喻：书让孩子了解更广阔的世界。

groups.label: C
groups.title: Why Do We Yawn?
groups.passage:
Everyone yawns. Babies yawn even before they are born. But why do we do it? Scientists still don't have a final answer, but they have some ideas.
One idea is that yawning helps to cool down the brain. When we yawn, we take in a lot of air. The cool air may help the brain work better, just like a fan cools a computer. That may be why people often yawn when they are tired or bored — the brain needs a short "refresh".
Another interesting fact is that yawning is catching. If you see someone yawn, you will probably yawn too. Some scientists think this is connected with how we understand other people's feelings. In one study, people yawned more often after watching their friends yawn than after watching strangers.
So next time you yawn in class, don't worry too much. Your brain may just be getting ready to learn!

items.stem: What is the first idea about why we yawn?
options: It keeps us awake at night.
It helps to cool down the brain.
It helps us breathe less air.
items.exp: 原文 One idea is that yawning helps to cool down the brain。

items.stem: The writer compares the brain to ____.
items.exp: 就像风扇给电脑降温，把大脑比作电脑。

items.stem: What does the word "catching" in Paragraph 3 mean?
items.exp: 看到别人打哈欠自己也会打，说明“会传染”。

items.stem: What is the best title for the passage?
items.exp: 文章介绍了打哈欠的原因和有趣事实。

sections.title: How to Make a Study Plan
sections.passage:
Do you often feel there is not enough time to finish your homework and review? A good study plan can help. (38)
First, write down all your tasks. Include homework, tests and other activities. (39)
Second, decide which tasks are the most important. Do the difficult ones when your mind is fresh. (40)
Third, give yourself short breaks. Studying for hours without rest makes you tired. (41)
Finally, check your plan every evening. If you didn't finish something, don't be hard on yourself. (42) Keep trying, and you will see the progress.
choices: Just move it to the next day's plan.
Here are some tips for you.
A ten-minute walk can help you feel better.
Then you will know clearly what you need to do.
For many students, this is in the morning.
You'd better play computer games after school.

items.exp: 下文分点给出建议，此处引出建议。
把任务都写下来，就能清楚知道要做什么。
头脑清醒的时候，对很多学生来说是早上。
短暂休息，比如散步十分钟，能让人感觉好些。
没完成的事不必自责，移到第二天的计划里。

sections.title: Our School Garden
sections.passage:
Last spring, our class started a small garden behind the (43) (library). Every student was given a piece of land. I (44) (plant) tomatoes and beans.
At first, it was not easy. Some seeds didn't come up, and the weeds grew (45) (quick) than the vegetables. Our biology teacher taught us how (46) (take) care of the plants. We watered them every morning and (47) (pull) out the weeds after school.
In July, we had our first harvest. We picked lots of (48) (tomato) and cooked a meal together. It was the (49) (delicious) meal I had ever eaten! Through this activity, I learned that hard work always pays (50) . I also learned to work with (51) (other). Now I am looking forward to (52) (grow) more vegetables next year.

items.exp: the 后用名词单数，图书馆后面。
叙述去年春天的事，用一般过去时。
修饰动词 grew，且有 than，用副词比较级 more quickly（faster 也可）。
how to do sth. 怎样做某事。
与 watered 并列，用一般过去时。
lots of 后接可数名词复数，tomato 的复数加 -es。
the ... I had ever eaten 用最高级。
hard work pays off 努力会有回报。
work with others 与他人合作。
look forward to doing sth.，to 是介词。

sections.prompt: 你校英语角正在开展“我的一次成长经历”征文活动。请以 A Lesson I Learned 为题写一篇短文，内容包括：1. 发生了什么事；2. 你从中学到了什么；3. 这件事对你现在的影响。要求：80—100 词，不出现真实姓名和校名。
points: 交代事情的经过，时间、人物、事件清楚
写出这件事对现在的影响
语言准确、衔接自然、书写规范
sections.sample:
A Lesson I Learned
Last term, I failed a math test because I didn't review carefully. I felt so upset that I didn't want to talk to anyone. My mother noticed it and said, "One test can't decide everything. Find out your mistakes and try again."
So I wrote down every mistake in a notebook and practised similar problems every day. In the final exam, I got a much better grade.
From this experience, I learned that failure is not the end. It shows us where we need to improve. Now whenever I meet difficulties, I don't give up easily. Instead, I look for the reasons and keep trying.
sections.exp: 先叙事，再写收获，最后写影响；多用 because、so、from this experience 等连接词。
